newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices recover in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices recover in quiet market.

text.p: Copper prices bounced back on fresh demand but other metals were steady on Thursday, traders said.
Ready copper rose by 100 rupees to 12,300 per quintal on renewed industrial buying at the reduced level coupled with restricted inflow. It was down by 50 rupees on Wednesday.
"The copper market was technically oversold and a correction was due," one broker said.

Nickel was steady at 36,200 rupees per quintal. Tin was quiet at 34,200 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,450 and lead at 4,450 in restricted activity. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,250 rupees per quintal.
